context: Reduce the excluded cell to a short muted label with the full reason on hover and in the accessible name. Preserve the DISTINCT reasons - trust policy versus insufficient query coverage are different facts and must not flatten to one string. Collapse unranked platforms only if D2 permits; if it does, the collapsed spanning row needs explicit handling in the role=grid focusPos coordinate model (MetaLeaderboard.tsx:83,339,378).
description:
Of 30 visible cells on the landing matrix, 8 read 'Excluded - Trust policy excludes this result from ranking' and 6 read 'No run'; 3 of 6 platforms carry no ranked figure at all. The exclusion LABEL is font-semibold in warning colour against plain numerals and the block runs four lines (MetaLeaderboard.tsx:561-567). The reason text itself is 10px - the defect is salience and block area, not type size.

Gated on rx-ux-00 D2 (ranked-scope default), which decides whether platforms with no ranked evidence may be collapsed by default.
